cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
project(WuzzNativeModules)

# Each Nitro module gets its own shared library, exactly as generated by
# `npx nitrogen` (one `add_library` + one `include(...+autolinking.cmake)`
# per module). Do not merge sources manually — the autolinking.cmake files list
# the full, authoritative set of generated sources for their target.

add_library(WuzzNitroText SHARED)
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../../packages/wuzz-nitro-text/nitrogen/generated/android/WuzzNitroText+autolinking.cmake)

add_library(WuzzShimmer SHARED)
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../../packages/wuzz-shimmer/nitrogen/generated/android/WuzzShimmer+autolinking.cmake)
